Reference

All functions

adversarial()

Adversarial contamination distribution

bias()

Bias of Pearson's correlation coefficient under contamination

breakdown()

Compute the breakdown value of Pearson's correlation coefficient. Consider a correlation functional at a contaminated distribution \(F_\varepsilon = (1 - \varepsilon) F + \varepsilon H\), where \(F\) is the model distribution, \(H\) is the contamination distribution, and \(\varepsilon \in [0, 0.5)\) is the contamination fraction. The breakdown value is defined as the smallest contamination fraction so that the correlation functional at the contaminated distribution flips its sign compared to the true correlation at the model distribution.
